Elaine (Sales): Quick handoff: Mandrake Therapeutics signed — Dedicated + Private (VPC), contract starts 2026-04-15. Pilot target 2026-05-03.

Elaine (Sales): Key constraints: Okta SSO, customer-managed KMS (cloud HSM), model pinning required, 6mo review clause in renewal. Expected ~1k reqs/day, p95 ~150ms.

Omar (CS): Taking lead on onboarding. I'll schedule kickoff next Tue 10am PT and draft a one-pager. Need Okta SP metadata + sandbox creds and group mapping.

Sasha (Support): On support side: I'll own runbook and oncall. Need log retention window, alert emails, and infra contact for firewall allowlist. Default retention 90 days until they decide.

Ben (Eng): I'll scope infra for private node and HSM integration. Need KMS ARN and confirm model to pin + quantization policy. Post-kickoff triage ETA 5 business days.

Elaine (Sales): Model = open-rlm/large-1.2 @v1.2. They allow 8-bit quant but require E2E tests with sample PHI prompts first. Simon (PM) will share KMS ARN and infra contact.

Omar (CS): Action list for week 1: 1) Kickoff invite 2) Collect SSO/KMS/infra details 3) Run infra ticket 4) Draft runbook + PHI test plan. I'll assign owners in the one-pager.

Sasha (Support): I'll post runbook checklist here by Mon. Also: escalation path and rollback steps included.

Ben (Eng): I'll open infra ticket after kickoff: infra create --component=private-deploy --customer=Mandrake --due=2026-04-20 --desc="SSO + KMS + model pinning scoping"

Elaine (Sales): I'll remain point for billing/procurement until transfer complete. Tag me for any contract questions.

Omar (CS): Confirmed. I'll update thread with kickoff invite + doc link. :thumbsup:
